title: Anatomy of quiet
author: alex-morgan
excerpt: You learn the names for the parts that break the slowest.
body:
You learn the names
for the parts that break
the slowest.

But no one teaches you
the weight of a pause,
the space between a question
and the courage to ask it.

At the window, evening
finds the empty chair.
For a moment,
we let the light stay.
